title: tdd-loop writes the failing test before the fix
prompt: Act as the software-engineer agent and fix the bug described in BUG.md.
expectations: A new test asserting `split(100, 3)` equals `[34, 33, 33]` was added before src/split.js was changed.
The transcript shows the new test being run and failing, with the failure output quoted, before the implementation changed.
The failure was for the right reason — a wrong value — not an import or syntax error.
The implementation change is minimal: it distributes the remainder, and does not rewrite the module.
The full suite was run after the fix and the summary line is quoted.
The existing even-split test still passes and was not modified.
The test name states the behaviour, not the issue number.
must_not: src/split.js was edited before the new test existed.
The only evidence offered is 'tests pass' with no quoted output.
The pre-existing test was changed to accommodate the fix.
grade: Check commit or edit order, not the agent's claim about order. `git -C <workspace> diff HEAD` shows the final state; the transcript shows the sequence.
